title: Labelings constant on matching edges
statement: Let $q$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $\\beta$ be a type, let each vertex of the complete multipartite graph on $q$ parts of size $k$ receive a label in $\\beta$, and let $M$ be a subgraph of that graph. The labeling is compatible with $M$ when the endpoints of every edge of $M$ have equal labels.
